summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Avino Silver & Gold Mines Ltd. reporting its record Q1 2026 financial results via press release. The filing discloses operational and financial metrics, such as revenues of $39.4 million and net income of $15.9 million, but does not involve any transaction, strategic review, or corporate event constituting a special situation. It is a routine earnings announcement by a foreign private issuer, not a classification event under the defined categories. No deal terms, recommendations, or structural changes are present.
